fields.summary_ko.0: Lam Research (LRCX) closed October 23 at $230.10, down -46.8% from June peak, but reported 5 consecutive quarters of record revenue.
fields.summary_ko.1: Current P/E 34.1x down from June's 74.6x but still elevated versus September prior year's 29.1x; 12-month operating margin 37.0%, highest since 2017.
fields.summary_ko.2: December quarter revenue expected at $8.75B (company guidance $8.2–9.0B); wafer fab equipment capex forecast to exceed $200B by 2027.
